title: EULER-ADAS: Energy-Efficient & SIMD-Unified Logarithmic-Posit Engine for Precision-Reconfigurable Approximate ADAS Acceleration
summary: Advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) require neural compute engines that deliver low-latency inference under strict power and area constraints. Posit arithmetic is attractive for such accelerators because it provides high numerical fidelity at low precision, but its variable-length regime encoding increases encode/decode cost and exposes the datapath to large regime-field fault effects. This paper presents EULER-ADAS, a SIMD-enabled logarithmic bounded-Posit neural compute engine for energyefficient and reliability-aware ADAS acceleration.
